Ambient storage has a minimum monthly charge of PLN 80 per client account. The minimum applies to
the storage line item only; it is not a minimum for parcel fulfillment.

Published prices exclude any taxes. A
single order can create more than one parcel, but the fulfillment fee is always assessed per dispatched
parcel. 8.2 When a service credit applies
A client may request a credit when Harborline misses the published dispatch deadline for an eligible,
on-time accepted order. The standard credit is 20% of the fulfillment fee for the affected parcel; it is not
20% of the merchandise value or the entire invoice. Total service credits for one client are capped at PLN
300 per calendar month. No standard dispatch credit is payable for an order received after the published cutoff, a
customer-address validation failure or a documented force-majeure interruption.

A late carrier delivery
after an on-time dispatch is not itself a standard credit trigger. Contract-specific remedies outside this
handbook are not part of this benchmark. 8.3 Submission deadline and arithmetic
Clients must submit service-credit requests within ten business days after the end of the service month. Finance validates accepted timestamps, carrier scans, exclusions and the monthly cap. For one eligible
late Express parcel, the standard 20% credit is PLN 2.84 (20% of PLN 14.20), subject to the client monthly
cap. CALCULATION EXAMPLE
Ten Express parcels plus five Chilled Grocery parcels cost PLN 239.50 in fulfillment fees, before storage and
taxes.
